strings.zh: 啊,你好！{SCROLL}还真是冷呐~{NEWLINE}冻死人啦~{SCROLL}听说你对神都遗迹感兴趣？{NEWLINE}年纪轻轻,还真了不起啊！{SCROLL}新奥地区和城都地区的{NEWLINE}文明相互融合于这点,{CLEAR}从神都遗迹里石柱的设计上,{CLEAR}也可见一斑呢~{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ah, hello! It sure is cold, isn’t it?{NEWLINE}I’m freezing to death!{SCROLL}I hear you’re interested in the{NEWLINE}Sinjoh Ruins? So young, and already{CLEAR}so impressive!{SCROLL}You can see how the cultures of Sinnoh{NEWLINE}and Johto blended together just from{CLEAR}the design of the Sinjoh Ruins’ pillars!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0145/0 | RV049: omission: US dropped 冻死人啦, 听说 and 年纪轻轻,还真了不起; added 'Take a look'

strings.zh: 哦呀哦呀！我怎么会这么失礼！{SCROLL}站着说话也不太方便吧？{NEWLINE}随我一起去前面的山间小屋里,{CLEAR}慢慢地详谈吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh my, oh my! How rude of me!{SCROLL}It’s not easy to talk standing around{NEWLINE}like this, is it? Come with me to the{CLEAR}mountain cabin up ahead, and we can{CLEAR}talk it over properly!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0145/1 | RV049: omission: US dropped 我怎么会这么失礼

strings.zh: 啊,对了！{NEWLINE}山间小屋里来了一位稀客哦！{SCROLL}训练师界里众所周知的新奥名人！{SCROLL}他好像是边在各地旅行,{NEWLINE}边调查神话和古代的遗迹~{CLEAR}真是厉害呢！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, that’s right! We have a rare guest{NEWLINE}at the mountain cabin!{SCROLL}A famous Sinnoh celebrity{NEWLINE}every Trainer knows!{SCROLL}Word is, this person is traveling all{NEWLINE}over, investigating myths and ancient{CLEAR}ruins. Amazing, isn’t it?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0145/2 | RV049: omission: US dropped 稀客 and 名人; pronoun kept neutral as zh 他 for the guest

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『阿尔宙斯以外的{NEWLINE}精灵就暂时存进箱子里吧！
strings.en: Cynthia: Put all your Pokémon{NEWLINE}except Arceus in a Box for now!

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『请带上你的阿尔宙斯。{SCROLL}如果带上其他的精灵,{NEWLINE}也许会被遗迹里漂浮的{CLEAR}强大能量弹飞……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Bring your Arceus only.{SCROLL}Other Pokémon may get blown away by{NEWLINE}the strong power lingering at{CLEAR}the ruins.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『你的阿尔宙斯也{NEWLINE}与遗迹产生共鸣了？{SCROLL}如果我的判断没错的话,{NEWLINE}这里充斥着强大的力量。{SCROLL}答案就在遗迹里,{NEWLINE}等着与主人见面。{CLEAR}就在{VAR:FF00:1}光之舞台{VAR:FF00:0}……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Is your Arceus resonating{NEWLINE}with the ruins too?{SCROLL}If I’m right, this place is filled{NEWLINE}with powerful energy.{SCROLL}The answer lies inside the ruins,{NEWLINE}waiting to meet its master.{SCROLL}At the {VAR:FF00:1}Mystri Stage{VAR:FF00:0}...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0145/5; modernised from US 0145#5 | RV049: meaning: US 'it might just be me' = 如果我的判断没错 reversed; question restored

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『阿尔宙斯！借我们力量吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Arceus! Lend us your power!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这里是神都遗迹。
strings.en: The Sinjoh Ruins

strings.zh: 古老的精灵雕像。{SCROLL}要摸摸看吗？
strings.en: An ancient Pokémon statue.{SCROLL}Touch it?

strings.zh: 坂木『帝牙卢卡,现在轮到你{NEWLINE}成为我的手下了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Dialga, now it’s your{NEWLINE}turn to become my servant.

strings.zh: 坂木『帝牙卢卡,现在轮到你{NEWLINE}成为我的手下了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Dialga, now it’s your{NEWLINE}turn to become my servant.

strings.zh: 帝牙卢卡『Diaaa——ga！
strings.en: Dialga: Diaaa-ga!

strings.zh: 帝牙卢卡在嘶吼着。
strings.en: Dialga is roaring.

strings.zh: 坂木『想反抗吗……{NEWLINE}真是遗憾,{CLEAR}在特制球面前你做什么都是徒劳。
strings.en: Giovanni: Resisting...? How{NEWLINE}unfortunate. Against a Special{CLEAR}Ball, anything you do is futile.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『坂木！快把帝牙卢卡放了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Giovanni! Let Dialga go, now!

strings.zh: 坂木『哦？竟然能这么快追到这里来。
strings.en: Giovanni: Oh? You caught{NEWLINE}up with us here so quickly.

strings.zh: 赤日『老大,要跟这家伙战斗吗？
strings.en: Cyrus: Boss, shall I fight this one?

strings.zh: 坂木『我还要在这里找一下{NEWLINE}通往帕路奇亚空间的「白玉宝珠」。{CLEAR}你替我抵挡一阵子。
strings.en: Giovanni: I still need to search{NEWLINE}here for the Lustrous Orb,{CLEAR}which leads to Palkia’s space.{CLEAR}Hold this one off for a while.

strings.zh: 赤日『遵命！
strings.en: Cyrus: As you command!

strings.zh: 赤日『坂木老大还有事要忙,{NEWLINE}就让我陪你玩玩吧！
strings.en: Cyrus: Boss Giovanni still has{NEWLINE}business to attend to, so I’ll play{CLEAR}with you for a while!

strings.zh: 赤日『啊……到极限了吗……
strings.en: Cyrus: Ah... Is this my limit...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这次坂木没有马上撤退,{NEWLINE}而是说去找什么「白玉宝珠」。{CLEAR}那到底是什么东西？{CLEAR}不想吃苦头就老实交代！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This time Giovanni didn’t{NEWLINE}retreat right away. He said he was{CLEAR}looking for some Lustrous Orb.{SCROLL}What is that thing? If you don’t{NEWLINE}want to suffer, start talking!

strings.zh: 赤日『切,你以为我会告诉你吗？
strings.en: Cyrus: Tch. You think I’d tell you?

strings.zh: 坂木『在研钵山的最深处{NEWLINE}使用「白玉宝珠」,{CLEAR}就能前往传说中的精灵「帕路奇亚」{CLEAR}所在的地方。
strings.en: Giovanni: Use the Lustrous Orb in{NEWLINE}the deepest part of Mt. Mortar, and{CLEAR}you can reach the place where the{CLEAR}legendary Pokémon Palkia dwells.

strings.zh: 赤日『老大……？
strings.en: Cyrus: Boss...?

strings.zh: 坂木『没关系,我刚刚找到了白玉宝珠,{NEWLINE}这家伙想阻止我们已经来不及了。
strings.en: Giovanni: It doesn’t matter. I’ve{NEWLINE}just found the Lustrous Orb. It’s{CLEAR}too late for this one to stop us.

strings.zh: 坂木『骑拉帝纳、帝牙卢卡、帕路奇亚,{NEWLINE}它们是通往终极力量的三把钥匙,{CLEAR}如今我们火箭队已经得到了两个。{CLEAR}最后的帕路奇亚就在研钵山,{CLEAR}你如果觉得能阻止我们,{CLEAR}就尽管追来试试好了。{CLEAR}我很期待再次看到{CLEAR}你因失败而沮丧的表情。
strings.en: Giovanni: Giratina, Dialga and{NEWLINE}Palkia are the three keys to the{CLEAR}ultimate power, and Team Rocket{CLEAR}already holds two of them.{SCROLL}The last, Palkia, is on Mt. Mortar.{NEWLINE}If you think you can stop us,{CLEAR}by all means, follow us and try.{SCROLL}I look forward to seeing that dejected{NEWLINE}look of defeat on your face again.
strings.notes: three keys to the ultimate power, as 0065 #66

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不用去什么研钵山了,{NEWLINE}我就在这里把你打倒！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I don’t need to go to{NEWLINE}Mt. Mortar. I’ll beat you right here!

strings.zh: 坂木『真是心急啊。{SCROLL}坂木『金刚宝珠,送我们回去！
strings.en: Giovanni: So impatient.{SCROLL}Giovanni: Adamant Orb, send us back!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可恶！又直接使用宝珠……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Dammit! He used{NEWLINE}the Orb to escape again...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『现在不是生气的时候,{NEWLINE}坂木说他们要去研钵山最深处……{CLEAR}无论这里面是否有诈,{CLEAR}都要尽快去确认一下才行。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This is no time to get{NEWLINE}angry. Giovanni said they’re going to{CLEAR}the deepest part of Mt. Mortar...{SCROLL}Whether it’s a trap or not, I need{NEWLINE}to go check as fast as I can.

strings.zh: 坂木『终于见到你了,帕路奇亚！{NEWLINE}你的空间能力是将白银山之雪{CLEAR}引到南方小岛的关键。{CLEAR}现在你就乖乖进入特制球,{CLEAR}成为我的手下吧！
strings.en: Giovanni: At last we meet, Palkia!{NEWLINE}Your power over space is the key{CLEAR}to bringing the snow of Mt. Silver{CLEAR}to an island in the south.{SCROLL}Now get into the Special Ball like a good{NEWLINE}little Pokémon and become my servant!
strings.notes: 'bring the snow of Mt. Silver to an island in the south' as 0065 #66/#67

strings.zh: 帕路奇亚『Paaaa——kia！
strings.en: Palkia: Paaaa-kia!

strings.zh: 坂木『什么！？特制球消失了？
strings.en: Giovanni: What?! The{NEWLINE}Special Ball vanished?

strings.zh: 坂木『我懂了,你用自己的空间能力{NEWLINE}把特制球传送走了吧？{CLEAR}在这么多传说精灵中,{CLEAR}你还真是最特别的一个啊。
strings.en: Giovanni: I see. You used your{NEWLINE}power over space to send the{CLEAR}Special Ball away, didn’t you?{CLEAR}Of all the Legendary Pokémon,{CLEAR}you really are the most special.

strings.zh: 坂木『既然如此,{NEWLINE}我就通过战斗耗尽你的体力,{CLEAR}让你无法使用空间能力。{SCROLL}坂木『出来吧,尼多王、铁甲暴龙！
strings.en: Giovanni: In that case, I’ll wear{NEWLINE}down your strength in battle until{CLEAR}you can’t use your power over space.{SCROLL}Giovanni: Come out, Nidoking, Rhydon!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『那个联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}已经追到研钵山来了,{CLEAR}帕路奇亚的捕捉还没完成吗？
strings.en: Ariana: That League Champion, {VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}has already followed us to Mt. Mortar.{CLEAR}Haven’t we finished catching Palkia yet?

strings.zh: 赤日『这么快就追到研钵山了？
strings.en: Cyrus: Already on Mt. Mortar?

strings.zh: 冥王『特制球似乎对帕路奇亚无效,{NEWLINE}老大正在通过战斗削弱帕路奇亚,{CLEAR}恐怕要再等一会儿才能捕捉完成。
strings.en: Charon: The Special Balls don’t{NEWLINE}seem to work on Palkia. The boss is{CLEAR}weakening Palkia in battle. I’m afraid{CLEAR}the capture will take a while longer.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『那个联盟冠军{NEWLINE}可能马上就到,{CLEAR}我们需要为老大争取一下时间才行。{CLEAR}但我已经没有能战斗的精灵了,{CLEAR}所以只能靠你们阻截那家伙,{CLEAR}没有问题吧？
strings.en: Ariana: That League Champion{NEWLINE}could be here any moment. We{CLEAR}need to buy the boss some time.{SCROLL}But I don’t have any Pokémon left that{NEWLINE}can fight, so it’s up to you two to{CLEAR}stop that one. Any problem with that?

strings.zh: 赤日『只凭我一个人{NEWLINE}确实不是那个冠军的对手。
strings.en: Cyrus: On my own, I’m certainly{NEWLINE}no match for that Champion.

strings.zh: 冥王『但如果两人联手的话……{NEWLINE}哼哼,打败他也未必不可能。
strings.en: Charon: But if the two of us{NEWLINE}team up... Heh heh. Beating{CLEAR}him isn’t out of the question.

strings.zh: 冥王『但如果两人联手的话……{NEWLINE}哼哼,打败她也未必不可能。
strings.en: Charon: But if the two of us{NEWLINE}team up... Heh heh. Beating{CLEAR}her isn’t out of the question.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『不要只会说大话,{NEWLINE}赶紧行动起来。
strings.en: Ariana: Stop talking big and{NEWLINE}get moving.

strings.zh: 铁甲暴龙『Ryyy——don！{NEWLINE}尼多王『Niiii——do！
strings.en: Rhydon: Ryyy-don!{SCROLL}Nidoking: Niiii-do!

strings.zh: 坂木『铁甲暴龙、尼多王,{NEWLINE}努力去给帕路奇亚造成伤害吧！
strings.en: Giovanni: Rhydon, Nidoking, do{NEWLINE}all the damage you can to Palkia!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『雅典娜、赤日、冥王,{NEWLINE}你们还没离开。{CLEAR}也就是说帕路奇亚{CLEAR}还没有被你们捉到吧？{CLEAR}看来这次终于被我给赶上了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ariana, Cyrus, Charon, you’re{NEWLINE}still here. That means you haven’t{CLEAR}caught Palkia yet, right? Looks like{CLEAR}this time I finally made it in time.

strings.zh: 赤日『帕路奇亚已经是{NEWLINE}我们火箭队的囊中之物,{CLEAR}你休想阻止这次抓捕。
strings.en: Cyrus: Palkia is already as good as Team{NEWLINE}Rocket’s. You won’t stop this capture.

strings.zh: 冥王『虽然你能单挑打败我们几个,{NEWLINE}但如果我和赤日联手的话,{CLEAR}你就准备受死吧！
strings.en: Charon: You may be able to beat{NEWLINE}us one at a time, but with Cyrus{CLEAR}and me together, prepare to die!

strings.zh: 赤日『竟然又让我尝到战败的滋味……
strings.en: Cyrus: To taste defeat yet again...

strings.zh: 冥王『我本以为有获胜希望的……
strings.en: Charon: I thought we had{NEWLINE}a chance of winning...

strings.zh: 雅典娜『两个干部只拖延了{NEWLINE}这么一小会儿吗！？{CLEAR}这下可糟糕了……
strings.en: Ariana: Two Executives, and they only{NEWLINE}held out this long?! This is bad...
{VAR:0103:0}: Stop right there!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『坂木老大,联盟冠……
strings.en: Ariana: Boss Giovanni,{NEWLINE}the League Champ...

strings.zh: 坂木『大针蜂,给它最后一击！
strings.en: Giovanni: Beedrill, finish it off!

strings.zh: 大针蜂『Beee——dil！
strings.en: Beedrill: Beee-dil!

strings.zh: 帕路奇亚『Paaaa…………{SCROLL}帕路奇亚有些撑不住了。
strings.en: Palkia: Paaaa...{SCROLL}Palkia is starting to falter.

strings.zh: 坂木『帕路奇亚,即使强大如你,{NEWLINE}战斗到现在也没体力了吧？{CLEAR}给我乖乖滚到特制球里来！
strings.en: Giovanni: Palkia, even one as mighty as{NEWLINE}you must be out of strength after all{CLEAR}this fighting. Now crawl into the Special{CLEAR}Ball like a good little Pokémon!
strings.notes: tone review: 滚 is contemptuous; 'crawl into' keeps the contempt, 乖乖 = 'like a good little Pokémon' (D-0627)

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: No! Stop!

strings.zh: 坂木『真是遗憾啊{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}这次的捕捉虽然有些波折,{CLEAR}但你还是来迟一步。
strings.en: Giovanni: What a pity, {VAR:0103:0}.{NEWLINE}This capture had its hiccups, but{CLEAR}you’re still one step too late.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『可恶,就差一点……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Dammit, I was so close...

strings.zh: 坂木『嗯,你脸上这副{NEWLINE}遗憾沮丧的表情非常美妙。{CLEAR}等我彻底击溃精灵联盟时,{CLEAR}你脸上又会是什么表情呢？{CLEAR}真是让人期待。
strings.en: Giovanni: Mm. That look of{NEWLINE}disappointment and dejection{CLEAR}on your face is exquisite.{SCROLL}What look will you wear when{NEWLINE}I crush the Pokémon League{CLEAR}completely? I can hardly wait.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『精灵联盟才不会被你击溃！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’ll never{NEWLINE}crush the Pokémon League!

strings.zh: 坂木『获得终极力量的三把钥匙{NEWLINE}都已经在我手上了,{CLEAR}迎接你们的只会是失败和死亡。{CLEAR}回去告诉达马兰奇,{CLEAR}让他洗干净脖子等着吧。
strings.en: Giovanni: I already hold all three{NEWLINE}keys to the ultimate power. All that{CLEAR}awaits you is defeat and death.{SCROLL}Go back and tell Goodshow to get{NEWLINE}his neck ready for the blade.

strings.zh: 坂木『白玉宝珠,带我们离开！
strings.en: Giovanni: Lustrous Orb, take us away!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『火箭队明明已经捕捉了{NEWLINE}骑拉帝纳、帝牙卢卡、帕路奇亚{CLEAR}三只无比强大的精灵,{CLEAR}却只是把它们定位成{CLEAR}获取终极力量的钥匙,{CLEAR}难道还有比它们更强的精灵吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Team Rocket has already{NEWLINE}caught Giratina, Dialga and Palkia,{CLEAR}three incredibly powerful Pokémon.{SCROLL}But they treat them as mere keys to{NEWLINE}the ultimate power. Could there be{CLEAR}a Pokémon even stronger than them?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『得尽快把这些情报{NEWLINE}告知精灵联盟才行。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I have to tell the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League about this as soon as{CLEAR}I can.

strings.zh: 帝牙卢卡正在注视着你,{NEWLINE}要尝试捕捉吗？
strings.en: Dialga is watching you.{NEWLINE}Try to catch it?

strings.zh: 帕路奇亚正在注视着你,{NEWLINE}要尝试捕捉吗？
strings.en: Palkia is watching you.{NEWLINE}Try to catch it?
